prices.note: Price is per module type, independent of finish/orientation. Types not sold individually (hardware, model-pending, or site-unlisted) are absent — treat missing as unpriced, not free.

*_hanger.notes: Hanging rods are not support sockets.

*_top_bar.notes: Display bars consume the back two sockets of the unit type matching their name.

booster_adapter.notes: Use two booster adapters across a deep-width unit to convert deep depth rows to standard-depth rows.

corner_*.notes: Corners should not share sockets with adjacent straight runs.

lamp.notes: Can attach to any available top socket.
